recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow source fix that completes the FHIR-17480 application without reopening later required-binding decisions or making broader terminology policy changes.
issue_request: FHIR-17480 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Vocabulary change request to clarify required binding strength and whether code datatype value-set and code-system versions can be left unspecified. The final Jira resolution replaced the required-binding text and included a specific rule that single external code system bindings do not need to specify a code-system version, while external value-set bindings must specify a value-set version.
initial_application: Commit 9500b398d1d850a06cd180c82ce330e4809a2b49 applied most of the voted R5 text to source/terminologies.html, including required binding strength for code elements, version requirements for multiple-code-system or HL7-defined code-system inputs, and external value-set version requirements. That patch left the prior generic external-standard bullet in place where the voted resolution called for the single-external-code-system exception.
additional_context: source/terminologies.html is the active Using Codes in Resources page, linked from the terminology module and datatype guidance. Later published issues FHIR-27144, FHIR-38962, and FHIR-39056 adjusted nearby expansion, code-vs-Coding, and maximum-binding-exception wording but did not supersede the FHIR-17480 single-external-code-system rule. The January 2022 Vocabulary WGM minutes record the FHIR-17480 motion and 20-2-5 vote.
reconciliation: Updated source/terminologies.html to replace the residual old external-standard bullet with the voted rule: when an element is bound to a single external code system such as MIME types, BCP47 language codes, or UCUM, the value set definition need not specify the code system version. The existing external value-set version requirement and later required-binding clarifications were preserved.
source_changes: source/terminologies.html: replaced the old generic external-standard required-binding bullet with the explicit single-external-code-system code-system-version clarification.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue clarified that required binding conformance is to the expansion of the bound value set and that expansions may change depending on value-set and code-system versions.
Later Published issue narrowed the code datatype rules so they apply to code outside Coding.
Later Published issue added the maximum-additional-binding exception to the general rule that code elements use required binding strength.
